deterministic_identity_decision.decision: Treat the CIIL/Bhasha Sanchika and Bharatavani 2013 records as catalogue/access manifestations of the same 2013 Rumbul grammar object. Do not create separate source identities for the two portals.
deterministic_identity_decision.edition_history_note: Bharatavani's index exposes a 1978 Rumbul Mundari Vyakaran entry, while an independent Austroasiatic bibliography lists a 1988 Ranchi edition/manifestation. These dates are preserved as edition-history leads and are not forced into a first/second/third-edition sequence without title-page or publisher evidence.
deterministic_identity_decision.manifestation_discrepancy: Bhasha Sanchika reports BVP00202.pdf as 9.04 KB whereas Bharatavani reports the 2013 PDF as 0.17 MB. The small repository object must not be assumed to be the complete grammar until bytes and page accounting are independently verified.

release_effect.gap_narrowed: Ramdayal Munda grammar now has exact CIIL handle/item/file metadata, Bharatavani manifestation metadata, and an explicit unresolved edition-history boundary. Complete lawful bytes, independent checksum, page accounting and edition-title-page evidence remain pending.
